scope: Real hardware provides frame-start 5-second bins. Replay uses the same source IDs, IRQ/SPI and ROM model, and MMC855 mean SPI calibration on both firmwares. Output is wall time from phase mark to phase return; pre-SEAL SPI, exclusive poll service, and remaining ARM time are disjoint. Queue occupancy, next-input SPI, and map acceptance are nested overlays. Final DMA is its first-to-last byte span; setup and publication are SNES service.
